input.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the fifteen self-authored valid encoded image byte streams in capture document order.
input.provenance: Self-authored PNG byte construction plus deterministic OpenCV JPEG encoding in tools/capture_image_decoder_oracle.py.

negative_input.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the five bounded negative encoded byte streams in capture document order.
negative_input.provenance: Self-authored malformed, unknown, boundary-header, and filename-confusion byte streams from tools/capture_image_decoder_oracle.py.

expected.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the fifteen raw C-order OpenCV IMREAD_COLOR BGR uint8 output arrays in capture document order.

limitations: This is exact evidence only for the fifteen self-authored image byte streams and the recorded OpenCV environment.
It does not select a Rust decoder, establish universal OpenCV equivalence, or approve every JPEG/PNG variant.
The 16-bit PNG and all negative cases are policy boundaries; D-008 must declare explicit supported or rejected behavior before decoder implementation.
It contains no model, dictionary, font, upstream image asset, OCR output, or end-to-end model golden.
